response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff/Senior Software Engineer with strong backend and microservices expertise, but he lacks the executive leadership experience required for a CTO role. He does not have a track record of scaling engineering organizations from 10 to 30+ people, and his experience with Agentic AI appears limited to recent individual contributor work rather than architectural leadership of production-grade multi-agent systems in high-stakes fintech environments.
strengths: Extensive backend and distributed systems experience, including low-latency microservices handling millions of requests per second.
Demonstrated familiarity with fintech and pricing systems from his time at RIDE Capital and Optilyz.
Recent hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling.
concerns: Lacks executive engineering leadership experience and a track record of scaling teams to 30+ engineers.
Missing deep production experience architecting and operating complex, stateful multi-agent AI systems at scale.
Profile is heavily oriented toward an Individual Contributor (IC) and software craftsman rather than a strategic technical executive.
